notes.title: Release of a new project on Steam
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34511351/1c2c0d5753b5e9c5a6e0b62f60739e9394bd39af.png

Hi all! We digress here...a little. As many have decided, the project has been abandoned. Yes and no. In fact, this project has grown into Conquistadors. The game is completely ready for release and will be available for download on January 24, 2024. The link to view the project in the store is below. The game is also available for mobile devices on Android (play market, huawei app gallery).

As for Aquatica, we will return later with details about the redesigned engine, controls and game mechanics.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2756400/Conquistadors/
